summary: The Cop spins out of the bathroom for cover while Neo's bullets splinter the door jamb. Just as he is about to whirl back in, he freezes as something seems to seize hold of him. His body starts to spasm, his M-16 falls to the ground, and long shadows spring up from the mounted flashlight.
